name: GDPR
description: EU General Data Protection Regulation — security-relevant articles (paraphrased).

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.description: Controllers maintain records of processing activities, including systems and assets involved.
controls.evidence_guidance: Asset inventory identifying systems that process personal data.

checks.rationale: A maintained inventory of systems underpins records of processing.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.description: Appropriate technical and organizational measures ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including regular testing and evaluation of effectiveness.
controls.evidence_guidance: Regular vulnerability testing, remediation, and security policies.

checks.rationale: Regularly testing security measures — recurring vulnerability scans are direct evidence.
Evaluating and acting on findings evidences effectiveness of measures.
Organizational measures require published security policy.

controls.title: Breach notification to supervisory authority
controls.description: Personal data breaches are notified to the supervisory authority without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours.

checks.rationale: A documented procedure covering the 72-hour window is the Art.33 readiness artifact.
Notification executes through the incident response program.

controls.title: Data protection impact assessment
controls.description: Where processing is likely to result in high risk, an assessment of the impact on personal data protection is carried out.

checks.rationale: A documented risk assessment covering data protection satisfies DPIA readiness.
